Task Status ​

Check task progress or stream real-time updates via SSE.

Get task status​

GET
/tasks/{task}

Returns the current status of a task. When status is success,
the output field contains signed URLs to generated images
(valid for 1 hour).

Authorizations​

apiKeyAuth

API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) obtained from the dashboard

Type
HTTP (bearer)
or
jwtAuth

JWT token obtained from /auth/login

Type
HTTP (bearer)

Parameters​

Path Parameters

task*

Task UUID

string
Required

"uuid"

Stream task status (SSE)​

GET
/tasks/{task}/stream

Server-Sent Events stream for real-time task status updates.
Each event contains a JSON-encoded task object. The stream
closes when the task reaches success or error status.

Authorizations​

apiKeyAuth

API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) obtained from the dashboard

Type
HTTP (bearer)
or
jwtAuth

JWT token obtained from /auth/login

Type
HTTP (bearer)

Parameters​

Path Parameters

task*

Task UUID

Type
string
Required
Format
"uuid"

Responses​

SSE stream of task status updates

text/event-stream
JSON
"string"
GET
